bestBets.overview: An interesting move not to claim on APACHE SONG. She's won races with 61kg and 60.5kg. Those wins were on a good 3 at MV and were the lead up to her placing in the Australia Stakes. She's not in that form now but have to concede she's fit and in the weakest race she's been in for a long time. CONSCIENCE has trialled ok for her return. She's unknown soft than a 6 and even then that form is mixed. SMART LITTLE MISS did enough 1st up. Not sure a heavy track is to her liking. Sam Kennedy has listed her riding weight for this meeting as 52kg. Her placing last time is good form for this. QUEEN CHRISTINE revelled on a home track H10 last time. Her Vic heavy record is very good. PACKERS JOURNEY is fit and flying. She handled a S7 at Donald to win her maiden. She's the outside here and for mine right in the game.

raceTips.comment:
I found this a borderline impossible race with major convictions against every horse relative to their price. 
I've sided with the race fit Mauna Kea Miss, who comes through a high-rating race behind Tennessee Bound last start. The end of 1200m is some concern for her however she can settle close to the speed and handles all conditions. 
Conscience created a big impression on debut but has been a touch disappointing since. Her recent jumpout was OK and the end of 1200m first up is a query. I suspect if she finds her best she'd win. 
Queen Christine won by six lengths last start in fast time on heavy ground and has a strong starting price profile. She looks very short given the rise in class and more particularly the unique nature of the heavy track she won on last start which I suspect many horses didn't handle.

bestBets.overview: The early market has it $5 the field which indicates what a tricky race this is. RUSSIAN FRONT should be ready 3rd up. He took great benefit from his midfield return behind MONGOLIAN CITY on testing ground with a very good 2nd to Struggle Street. He's in nicely here with Jackson Radley's claim.  MONGOLIAN CITY is 3 for 3 this prep around 1200m. He'll get on speed and make his own luck. TALKIN ITALIAN has been terrific on his home track heavy. If eh brings it to Sandown, he'll be hard to beat.  NIC'S CHOICE is an interesting one. He's raced on rain affected ground 3 times. Two are shockers and spelled straight away. One is ok. He's jumped out on a H10 at Cranbourne with smart horses and he looked to handle it well. Ex Hong Kong 8yo ALLGREEKTOME has been trialling well for his return. Betting?

raceTips.comment:
Another very tough flat race. Mongolian City is flying for the new stable having won three of his four starts this preparation. This is tougher and the forecast winds might be against him as a leader however he is hard fit, in great form and maps to control the race from the front. 
Talkin' Italian was dominant winning last start at Geelong second up off a long break defying the pattern of the day. Third up he might have further improvement to come. 
Russian Front looks set to peak third up with a more experienced jockey going on.

bestBets.overview: Lightly raced new season 4yo KOMITO is the one they'll have to beat. Love the way he lifted when Blue Willow raced up to challenge him when he won 2nd up. He should have no trouble with the rise to 2100m.  Blue Willow made the form look good during the week. If that's the right form then GIGGENBACH has to be a danger. She was 1st up when 3rd in the same race conceding KOMITO 4.5kg. This time it's just 1kg. DURBAN HARBOUR gets some handy weight relief for the rise in grade. His heavy form is solid. DON'T DOUBT DARE ran home well last time in a strong 3yo race. Scratchings have been good for SUNSETS who might get a great run on pace now.

raceTips.comment:
Komito did a terrific job winning second up at Sandown beating stable mate and subsequent winner Blue Willow, who looked to have him cold at the 200m mark. He did have the perfect run in transit but might strip fitter again third up and he has more upside than his rivals. 
Giggenbach had Komito's back last start and couldn't go with him but was first up off a break there and gets Blake Shinn on here so no surprise to see her bridge the margin. 
Durban Harbour hit the line hard at Seymour last start in a weaker race. He drops in weight here and can potentially settle closer.

bestBets.overview: Giving JUGIONG another go. The straight just didn't suit him at all last time and his effort was poor. Prior to that, he was here on a H9, probably worst part of the track and he ran well. He's had a good grounding to cope with running out a strong 1400m. CINTURATO beat him home in that race here where he was out in the better ground. Obviously he's going to be hard to beat. He likes a heavy track. So does COBBLESTONE WAY who is having a successful campaign. He will get his chance to run a strong 1400m. BLUE BANDIT had a torrid run last time. The bottom three are queries this wet. If the 5 week freshen for TERRITORIAN des the trick and he handles the heavy he goes close to winning.

raceTips.comment:
Cinturato looks well placed rising in distance and dropping in class with Ethan Brown going on. He's an excellent wet tracker and I suspect wet ground is the key to his best form.
If you make a case for Cinturato then Jugiong needs to be given respect. There wasn't much between them on July 1 and Jugiong was in the inferior part of the track. 
Ignore Blue Bandit's last start where he had a tough run. He loves wet ground and is hard fit.
